name: Nexus LLM policy panel simulation device
target: Owner-gated /v1/llm/policy panel GET/PUT over a temporary config dir, driven through the real routes and the real validateLlmPolicy/loadLlmPolicy
inputs: an invalid schema document (wrong version, unknown field)
an empty config dir with no policy file
observations: 401 on non-owner PUT with the previous file byte-for-byte preserved
400 with non-empty rejection reasons on invalid schema, previous policy preserved
both concurrent PUTs return 200 and the file settles on one atomic write
missing-file GET returns the default policy with filePresent=false
